Music League Analytics

Weekly medals, season finishes, habits, heaters

The full friend-group music league record, sliced like standings night.

Every export is parsed round by round: weekly medals come from each round's submitter podium, completed season medals come from final standings, and current seasons show provisional leaders through the exported rounds only.

Data Notes

Source folder:

Weekly MedalsEach week ranks submitters by counted points from their submitted songs. Matching scores share the same weekly medal band.
No Vote, No PointsIf a submitter does not vote in a round, their songs' raw vote points remain visible in song stats, but those points are forfeited from standings and weekly podiums.
Season MedalsSeason gold, silver, and bronze come from final standings only. Current seasons show a provisional leader, not a medal.
Current RoundIf the live app has a newer active round than the zip, this page cannot know that round's leader until a fresh export includes its votes.
Voting ReliabilityThe denominator is only seasons where that person submitted or voted at least once. More seasons entered is context, not the ranking.
Scale ChangeEarlier exports include 0-3 point votes. Later exports use 0-2. Dominance views use round share or normalized vote spread.
Current SeasonThe current export is shown exactly as exported. Add a newer zip and rerun the generator to refresh the page.
